text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Pope John Paul II receives Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn in the Vatican today.
-- According to a survey, gypsies in Hungary can expect a life by 10 to 15 years shorter than the average of the population of the country.
-- The Budapest Court has begun Hungary's first trial, in which a member of Parliament attacked the decision of a special court dealing with the activity of MP's under the Communist regime.

-- Privatisation Minister Judit Csiha confirmed that Croatia claims $1 million from Hungary as Hungary did not fulfil all contracted arms transports to Croatia in 1990 after a scandal over the secret arms sales.
